findings.highlight: I’m going to guess about something bad.
findings.evidenceJa: とてつもなく悪い予感を口にするんだが
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is about to voice an extremely bad premonition.
findings.explanation: Guess about something bad is malformed and weakens the comic dread before his accusation.

findings.highlight: I gave that annoying Shinji some knuckles.
findings.evidenceJa: ナックルパートお見舞いしてきたわ
findings.governingReading: Rin says she treated the noisy Shinji to a “knuckle part,” setting up the bare/bear exchange.
findings.explanation: Some knuckles is not an intelligible attack expression and weakens the staged wordplay.

findings.highlight: you still retain the blood of it
findings.evidenceJa: まだちゃんと血を残している遠坂
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the Tohsaka line still properly preserves its magus bloodline.
findings.explanation: The dangling “of it” is malformed and obscures the contrast with the Matou lineage.

findings.highlight: no wonder he never gets enough of talking to me
findings.evidenceJa: どうりで懲りずに話しかけてくる筈だ
findings.governingReading: Rin realizes why Shinji keeps approaching and speaking to her without being discouraged by rejection.
findings.explanation: The English turns persistence despite discouragement into an appetite for conversation.

findings.highlight: I can’t get in the mood unless I’m setting the mood
findings.evidenceJa: やるなら自分からっていうか
findings.governingReading: Rin says that if a contest or advance is going to happen, she has to initiate it herself.
findings.explanation: Setting the mood replaces agency and competitive initiative with an unrelated romantic-emotional idiom.

findings.highlight: how skilled you are in magic
findings.evidenceJa: シロウの魔術がどれほどの腕なのか
findings.governingReading: Saber wants Rin’s assessment of Shirou’s level of Magecraft.
findings.explanation: Generic magic again erases the work’s technical category and makes skill attach to a broader supernatural idea.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka leaves the living room, still in a bad mood.
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と不機嫌そうなまま居間を後にする遠坂。
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends with Rin’s instruction; her displeased departure narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores obsolete narration and supplies an additional emotional exit beat absent from the active witness.
